prompts.marches-artisanat: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production mobile map category marker for Moments Locaux, a friendly premium French local-events app. A single isolated object silhouette, itself the marker, NO map pin, no enclosing graphical container, no badge, no circular backdrop, no lettering, no ground plane, no extra decorations. Truly TRANSPARENT alpha background. Square canvas, subject centered occupies 82% of width/height with generous safe margins. Art direction: bespoke soft sculpted 2.5D matte enamel, slightly inflated rounded edges, elegant simple broad color planes, very restrained bevels and ambient occlusion, gentle upper-left light, three-quarter frontal view with tiny perspective, NOT photorealistic, NOT line icon, NOT detailed toy scene. Readable as 40px mobile icon; extremely simple large silhouette and no tiny details. Palette Moments Locaux deep forest #1A3329, pale mint #E8F5E9 accents plus category color. Thin dark colored dimensional side edge for contrast over a pale map, no white sticker stroke. No external cast shadow, only object self-shading. Subject: MARCHES & ARTISANAT. A single stylized market basket with one broad arched handle and a compact rounded trapezoid woven body. DOMINANT color exactly current category cyan blue #0EA5E9, both handle and basket. Only four or five broad gently interwoven bands to suggest craft, no fine weave texture. Blue shaded sides and light cyan highlights, tiny pale mint inner rim at most. A premium sculpted slightly inflated market basket, recognizable silhouette at 40px. Empty basket: no food, no goods, no tag, no labels.
